injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
